reading: 7 of 1214 usable instructions survived as real caller-set demand (4 strict, 7 including weak). The screen over-includes on purpose so a human can reject; every rejection is recorded here instead of being remembered as a narrative.

verdict_legend.paste: not the user's own words: an agent report or another model's review that survived own_words
verdict_legend.not_demand: the needle fired on something that is not a code symbol (docs, filenames, SQL, hosting)
